title: Ghostnote Dash
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -6 dB gain before AAC encoding; stream-only limiter at 0.35 linear amplitude with no makeup gain. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Original all-ages liquid drum-and-bass instrumental for a one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game at a STRICT constant 172 BPM in 4/4. From the FIRST SECOND through the final bar keep a clear quantized two-step grid: short punchy kick on beats one and three, dry prominent snare on two and four, distinct closed eighth-note hats, and light ghost-snare or muted-key taps between the main backbeats. Keep at least eight separate short midrange transients in every two-bar phrase, including the quieter middle. No tempo drift, half-time breakdown, beatless intro, drum dropout, free-time section or smeared pad-only bridge. Signature hook: three clipped low synth notes in a falling syncopated pattern, answered one eighth-note later by two high glass-key notes that leap upward. The ghost taps add motion without hiding the main snare or the pitched hook. Support with a nimble round sub bass and short warm chord fragments. At the midpoint retain the SAME uninterrupted two-step grid, let the high glass-key answer come first and move the falling synth line to a new root; the ending combines both motifs into a fresh staggered cadence instead of copying the opening. One evolving 128-second stereo instrumental, fast but friendly, with clean separated attacks and no abrasive distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original duohertz album cover for Ghostnote Dash, an all-ages drum-and-bass rhythm-game track. Original high-contrast editorial comic-print collage on near-black ink. Main motif: ONE enormous warm-ivory angled paper beat mark shaped like a broad diagonal slash, with exactly TWO translucent electric-cyan offset echo imprints trailing just behind it. Three tiny coral timing ticks sit along the gap between the main slash and the first echo; they read as ghost notes, not text. Strong forward motion, tactile cut-paper edge, sparse halftone and one tiny warm-yellow accent. The three layered slashes must remain visually distinct at 100px, with calm dark space in the lower fifth for a local title overlay. No literal ghost, person, road, vehicle, speedometer, lightning bolt, circle, ring, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or copied game art.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Ghostnote Dash square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve one large warm-ivory diagonal paper beat slash and exactly two offset translucent electric-cyan echo imprints trailing behind it, plus three tiny coral ghost-note timing ticks, sparse halftone and near-black ink field. Recompose the motif on the RIGHT two-thirds, leaving calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines there: 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan and 'Ghostnote Dash' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. Make a purpose-built wide card, not a stretched square crop. No other text, letters, numbers, literal ghost, person, road, vehicle, logo, watermark or copied game art.
